1934, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 198 June 12 Sister Antoinine - enrolled about May 1 for broken back, after first x-ray photo - now reported coming O.K. Spinal cord in 2nd X-ray shows not broken. Deo Gr.
Lilly Pilloworth - 55 - terribly cancerous - beautifully resigned (Mercy Hall) asks to die ...
Mary O'Rourk .... Port Huron
CarrierCarrier - 53 - Episcopelian - Eye infection.
Florence Kistel Germaine Van Ryckezham - 38 - Gall-stone trouble - heart- Rheum ...
Eczema cases .. . .
Robert Rovost - 7 - "Cath. reals."
Page 199 June 13 Mrs. David Hall - 36 - "Christian Church" - Heart trouble
14 Stanley Shefka - 6 - in dying condition now 3 weeks in Child. Hosp. Drs. wondering what ... Father "Orthadox" ... Mother Enrolled To-day to make good confession ... away for 8 yrs. (Boy enrol'd before) mother 15 went to Holy Communion To-day brought boy home at 1:30 P.M. - smil- ing & happy.
Stella Kruesdale - 50 - gall-stones & apend.
Prescilla Peltier - improvement in employment.
19
Catholic Univ. of London, Ont. - Students ..... John Olszewski - 40 - cancer of throat very low - Wife & 7 - baby only 6 mo.
20 Baby Rose Rozie - 4 - imbicile, beautiful child - Father away from sacraments. Enrolled at 11:50 a.m.
Mrs. M. kliemann - 1501 McClellan - being done out of home. Hates to go to court but ... waits to settle out of Ct.
Page 200 June 21 James A. Havel - 9 - Lutheran of Utica - blind now 6 mo. two yrs. coming on ... Prays Jesus to make him see and his 12 yr. old Br. talent .... Enrolled this a.m.
